name: iMessage — the bug · dark (horizontal)
description: Dark-mode variant of the live Messages conversation overlay (same Surface, theme chosen from paperColor). Over ~6s: a gray received bubble pops in, a three-dot typing indicator resolves into the next bubble, a heart tapback pops on, then a blue sent reply arrives with a Delivered → Read receipt, and it holds. Chromeless (chrome: 'none', ADR-0037): just the dark-gray (left) / blue (right) bubbles with grouped tail curls floating over footage — no page, no header, no composer bar, film-insert style. Fully bare BY DESIGN (faithful-OS-artifact stance): no mono thread, no collage chrome; tail curls cut to genuine transparency; NO CSS glow. Transparent WebM overlay, composited over footage.

messages.text: the bottleneck was a console.log inside a hot loop
